name: Karma
notes: Karma is played as a pure caster here: her kit never touches basic attacks (no on-hit, no attack-speed steroid, no reset), so attack.never is set and attack-speed / on-hit items get no value from her, as instructed.

Opening: Mantra (R) is cast at t=0 (no cost, no cast time, cooldown starts on cast); its charge is spent immediately on the very next Q, turning it into Soulflare. The bonus impact and field damage this produces are attributed to R (the source of the empowerment), not Q, since Mantra itself never deals damage on its own cast.

Q (Inner Flame/Soulflare) is recast on cooldown for the rest of the fight; its impact damage lands on the cast (the 0.25s cast time is only the usual attack-lockout, per the Jax reference pattern) and, when Mantra-empowered, the field detonation lands 1.5s later per the wiki's stated field duration.

Whenever Mantra comes off cooldown it is recast immediately, and the resulting charge is always reserved for the next Q cast, never W or E, since only Q's Mantra bonus deals damage (per the dossier's rotation).
W (Focused Resolve) is cast on cooldown for its initial damage; since the dummy is stationary and never breaks the tether, its aftereffect damage always lands 2s later as well.
E (Inspire/Defiance) is never cast: it only shields/heals and has no offensive value against a stationary dummy, so it is skipped entirely.

Gathering Fire (Passive): read as each individual damage instance -- Q's impact and field separately, W's initial hit and aftereffect separately -- independently cutting Mantra's current cooldown by 4s, matching the wiki's 4x10=40s cap math for 5 champions hit by two instances each; this is the chosen reading of an ambiguous passage.
Mana costs are not modeled: Karma's costs (Q/W/E, 40-80 mana) are modest relative to a level-16 mana pool and are unlikely to bind inside a short fight.

Mantra's 8-second empowerment window (how long an unspent charge lasts) is quoted only in wiki text, not confirmed anywhere in the bin; it is listed under assumed and only matters for bookkeeping, since the rotation always spends the charge on the very next Q, well inside 8s.
